title: With his next catch, Justin Jefferson will pass Randy Moss on Vikings' all-time list

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: With his next catch, Justin Jefferson will pass Randy Moss on Vikings' all-time list
sources.description: With eight catches for 92 yards, two touchdowns, and a two-point conversion in a nutty Week 1 win over the Packers, Vikings receiver Justin Jefferson has 587 career receptions.
